# Security Policy

## Scope

SuperBase² is a fork of [supabase/supabase](https://github.com/supabase/supabase).
This policy covers the SuperBase² code only — the multi-project provisioning
under `docker/superbase2/`, the sb2 API handlers under
`apps/studio/pages/api/superbase2/`, and the sb2 additions to Studio.

Vulnerabilities in upstream Supabase itself should go to Supabase, not here:
https://github.com/supabase/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Email zbcoding@outlook.com. Please don't open a public issue.

Include the affected version or commit, what an attacker can do with the bug,
and the steps to reproduce it.

This is a personal project with no SLA. Expect a reply within a week.
